supersedes: Palm input in GoddessHand.json; automatic stage starts and checkpoint-style production retry in prior releases. PalmProgression023.json level order, balance and layout remain.

palm_water.aim: Open left palm, tracked palmar normal aimed at miniature ground
palm_water.activate: Any individually valid right fingertip touching the back of the left hand; right-hand closure and right-palm alignment are not required
palm_water.tracking: Quest checks individual fingertip validity/confidence; portable OpenXR preserves a per-tip validity mask and transforms all five tips into world space
palm_water.stop: Finger lifts, left palm closes, invalid current tracking, tool/sheep ownership, menus or gameplay pause. No stale pose firing.
palm_water.tutorial: Left hand stays open; right index finger points from the side, other right fingers curl. Palm stays clear of the left hand. Any right finger is accepted in actual input.

replay.scope: Production eight-level expedition; editor-only historical equipment fixtures retain old checkpoint tests
replay.allowed: Current stage in preparation, fighting, cleared, lost or won state
replay.reward: Fresh rescue earns fresh reward; repeated retry clicks without rescue earn nothing; each animal pays once per attempt
replay.next_level: Replay preserves current level index; next-level button remains separate

preparation.route: Enter level -> preview and ready button -> explicit click -> 3 seconds -> fight
preparation.pause: Focus loss, app pause and blocking panels stop countdown; delta clamped to prevent background catch-up
preparation.repeat: New Game, next level and retry all prepare. Returning from camp resumes existing phase.

sheep_interaction.grab: Near palm within 6.5 cm; first observe open hand then closure >= 0.42 for 0.08 seconds
sheep_interaction.release: Tracked closure below 0.20; holding follows smoothly and never awards currency directly
sheep_interaction.pet: Open hand or fingertip within 4.3 cm for 0.18 seconds; affection for 1.5 seconds, 2-second feedback cooldown
sheep_interaction.feedback: Happy head/ear/body motion, pink heart, shared bounded bleat voices
sheep_interaction.tracking_loss: Freeze briefly; release after 0.35 seconds of missing individual hand samples. Global pause/menu/recenter resets interaction.
sheep_interaction.landing: Return smoothly to the nearest valid island landing point if released outside terrain
sheep_interaction.ownership: One sheep per hand; a sheep cannot belong to both hands; held sheep do not block the evacuation queue
sheep_interaction.fire: Carried burning sheep still need water. Petting grants neither money nor fire immunity.
